IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.symmetric_keys WHERE name = '##MS_DatabaseMasterKey##')
    CREATE MASTER KEY;
GO

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.database_scoped_credentials WHERE name = 'SynapseManagedIdentity')
    CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL [SynapseManagedIdentity] WITH IDENTITY = 'Managed Service Identity';
GO

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.external_file_formats WHERE name = 'SynapseParquetFormat')
    CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT [SynapseParquetFormat] WITH (FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET);
GO

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.external_data_sources WHERE name = 'transportdw_externalstgaccmigration_dfs_core_windows')
    CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE [transportdw_externalstgaccmigration_dfs_core_windows]
    WITH (
        LOCATION = 'abfss://migrationcontainer@externalstgaccmigration.dfs.core.windows.net',
        TYPE = HADOOP,
        CREDENTIAL = [SynapseManagedIdentity]
    );
GO

IF OBJECT_ID('stage.External_NYCCabTrip_Green') IS NULL
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE stage.External_NYCCabTrip_Green (
	[VendorID] varchar(8000), [lpep_pickup_datetime] varchar(8000), [lpep_dropoff_datetime] varchar(8000),
	[store_and_fwd_flag] varchar(8000), [RatecodeID] varchar(8000), [PULocationID] varchar(8000),
	[DOLocationID] varchar(8000), [passenger_count] varchar(8000), [trip_distance] varchar(8000),
	[fare_amount] varchar(8000), [extra] varchar(8000), [mta_tax] varchar(8000), [tip_amount] varchar(8000),
	[tolls_amount] varchar(8000), [ehail_fee] varchar(8000), [improvement_surcharge] varchar(8000),
	[total_amount] varchar(8000), [payment_type] varchar(8000), [trip_type] varchar(8000),
	[congestion_surcharge] varchar(8000)
)
WITH (
	LOCATION = 'migration-test/nyccab/curated/green',
	DATA_SOURCE = [transportdw_externalstgaccmigration_dfs_core_windows],
	FILE_FORMAT = [SynapseParquetFormat],
	REJECT_TYPE = VALUE,
	REJECT_VALUE = 0
);
GO

IF OBJECT_ID('stage.External_NYCCabTrip_Yellow') IS NULL
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE stage.External_NYCCabTrip_Yellow (
    VendorID varchar(8000), lpep_pickup_datetime varchar(8000), lpep_dropoff_datetime varchar(8000),
    passenger_count varchar(8000), trip_distance varchar(8000), RatecodeID varchar(8000),
    store_and_fwd_flag varchar(8000), PULocationID varchar(8000), DOLocationID varchar(8000),
    payment_type varchar(8000), fare_amount varchar(8000), extra varchar(8000), mta_tax varchar(8000),
    tip_amount varchar(8000), tolls_amount varchar(8000), improvement_surcharge varchar(8000),
    total_amount varchar(8000), congestion_surcharge varchar(8000)
)
WITH (
	LOCATION = 'migration-test/nyccab/curated/yellow',
	DATA_SOURCE = [transportdw_externalstgaccmigration_dfs_core_windows],
	FILE_FORMAT = [SynapseParquetFormat],
	REJECT_TYPE = VALUE,
	REJECT_VALUE = 0
);
GO
